description: Update an AI memory item (partial). Stamps updated_at. Set entity + entity_id to re-attach a note to a record (e.g. entity='lead', entity_id=<lead id>); pass entity_id null to make it tenant-wide. category is a free topical label. occurred_at (ISO) = the fact's original date in its source system. Use this to fix mis-scoped notes instead of delete+recreate. (Legacy: parent_id is accepted as entity_id.)

content.description: New text content of the memory item

entity_id.description: Record id to attach to; null = tenant-wide

item_id.description: ID of the item to change

name.description: Name of the AI memory item

occurred_at.description: ISO date the fact originated in its source system

name: update_ai_memory_item
